items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: No, I don't know his name, but I can't call it now. Sonny Boy Williams? Mm-mm.

ctx.x: I made a couple with him and I made some with this guy to put a harmonica in the guitar. What do you mean? Y'all want him too. Not even one? No, but it would be New York, Sonny Terry Williams.
Hmm? Joe Williams. No, no. Sonny Terry in New York. You never made a place.
No, I don't know his name, but I can't call it now. Sonny Boy Williams? Mm-mm. Wait. Let's see. Who's some harmonica players?
